Message from you:
What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Message from Lumo :
If you’re dealing with a defective item, the warranty depends on the product: 
Mattresses: Every mattress purchased directly from Endy.com includes a 10-year Limited Warranty by default. If you register as an Endy VIP, coverage extends to a 15-year Limited Warranty at no additional cost. If there’s a covered manufacturer defect during the warranty period, we’ll offer a one-time replacement or repair of the original mattress size purchased (no fee or deductible).
Endy rugs (Grey Geometric Rug and Hand-Loomed Jute Rug): Covered by a 1-Year Limited Warranty. If there’s a covered manufacturing defect within 1 year, we’ll offer a one-time replacement or repair (no fee or deductible).
For mattresses, the Limited Warranty covers (during normal wear and use): 
Degradation causing a visible indentation greater than one (1) inch (not associated with an improper foundation)
Any physical flaw that causes the foam material to split or crack despite normal usage and proper handling
Any defect or flaw in the zipper assembly of the mattress cover (Endy Mattress only)
For mattresses, the Limited Warranty does not cover: 
Normal increase in softness after long-term use
Comfort preference or mattress height preference
Stains, burns, tears, cuts, or liquid/moisture damage
Damage due to use with an inappropriate foundation
Products sold by an unauthorized retailer or sold as “used”/not “new”
Damage to fabric handles as a result of improper handling (Endy Hybrid Mattress only)
